build_ray_directions: build a python module to compute ray directions for all pixels given image height, width, and focal length
build_world_rays: build a python module to get ray origins and directions in world coordinates from camera directions and c2w matrix
create_pdf_sampling: create a function that performs hierarchical PDF sampling along ray bins using weights for NeRF rendering
create_ray_marcher: create a function that samples points along rays with linear or disparity spacing and optional perturbation
read_pfm_file: read a PFM format image file and return the numpy array data and scale factor
